resources.string: The goal: take every card up to these four places, from Ace to King, one suit in each.
An Ace goes straight up. Just touch a card: it goes to the best place by itself.
Touch the 2♠. It goes up, onto its Ace.
In the columns, cards go down in order, red and black taking turns: the red 6 goes onto the black 7.
Touch the black 5♠. It goes onto the red 6.
No more moves? Touch the pile to turn a new card.
Only a King can go to an empty column. Touch the King.
Not sure what to play? Touch Hint.
The game shows a move: the red Queen onto the black King. Touch the Queen.
Changed your mind? Touch Undo to take the last move back.
That’s it! Take every card up, from Ace to King. Have a good game!
